name: Feels Like Home
s: The heartwarming journey of four boys, Avi, Lakshay, Sameer, and Gandhi, as they struggle to make their first house a home. Along the way, they discover true friendship, love, heartbreak, family, an iguana named Godzilla, and what it means to 'feel like home'.

paragraphs.text: Feels Like Home is a 2022 Indian Hindi-language Comedy drama streaming web series directed by Sahir Raza. The series is created and produced by Sidhanta Mathur under the banner of Writeous Studios. The series stars Anshuman Malhotra, Mihir Ahuja, Prit Kamani and Vishnu Kaushal in the lead alongside Himika Bose and Inayat Sood. The series premiered on Lionsgate Play on 10 June 2022. A second season premiered on the service on 7 October 2022.
